Frequent conflicts demonstrate an active treatment, not that interference caused the behavioral bottleneck. Lower likelihood losses and favorable leave-one-group-out signs neither establish transferable gains nor justify extension. The latter are overlapping fitting-set diagnostics, not independent replications. Projection also changes magnitude and direction; this contrast does not isolate a pure interference-removal effect.

The oracle exclusion results are correctly described as unavailable change knowledge, neither achievable policy accuracy nor a ceiling. No transfer experiment, repeat, extension, or promotion is justified.

For the next direction, I recommend a **separately scoped, no-fit audit of destination discrimination in existing fitting artifacts**: examine gold destinations versus the highest-ranked incorrect nonrepeat alternatives, and determine which relevant geometry/entity distinctions the causal execution inputs actually preserve. V34–V36 motivate this because suppressing repetition still leaves substantial alternative-ranking error. This goes beyond another ranking summary and could support a specific representation hypothesis; it does not yet justify an architecture or establish missing information as the cause. Do not default to more memory, generic CNNs, entity attention, hierarchy auxiliaries, or additional training given their prior evidence.

G00/L02/JP02 references, category-90%, reliability, and three-seed requirements remain binding.
